schemas.description: Read retained tool/view data without rerunning its action. id is modelContext.resultId or the last segment of view. all=true returns the whole selected value as typed JSON in one call; otherwise JSON text pages have nextCursor. Optional JSON pointer selects /rows/0 or /flowMap. References expire with retention; save important evidence to task memory. Private to the original user/story.
